utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Kira, I heard folks are gathering tools and spare parts for the repair drive this weekend—sounds like half the block wants to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Maybe, but are we sure who's organizing it and what they actually need before everyone starts hauling stuff over?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Fair point—I heard Mara and Dev were pulling it together, but I’d rather check before I start spreading the wrong list around.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m helping spread the word about the repair drive, Noah—figured I’d mention it around the block so more folks show up.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, the repair drive, yeah. Thanks for telling me, Vik; I probably would've missed it otherwise.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yep, I’ve been telling everyone on the block about the repair drive so nobody misses it—figured I’d make sure you heard too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help Saturday morning—what tools do we still need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Saturday morning’s great—right now I think we still need a couple of hammers, work gloves, and maybe an extra ladder.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it—I can bring a hammer and work gloves. I don’t have an extra ladder, though.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard a few folks are bringing tools, but I was hoping to ask you what still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: From what I’ve got written down, we still need help with two porch steps, a leaky gutter on Maple, and one busted fence panel by the garden.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it—if nobody’s claimed the fence panel yet, I can take that one. Do you know whether we’ve got spare boards already?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with the repair drive, but I need to work around school pickup—what time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’d be great—would 3:30 work for you, right after pickup?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 3:30 works for me if we keep it fairly quick, since I’ll have the kids with me.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m in for the repair drive, Oren, but let’s set a clear schedule and list what needs fixing first.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That makes sense, Eli—I’ll jot down the fixes so I don’t lose track again, and we can pick a time that works for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good—once you’ve got the list, let’s meet tomorrow morning and sort it in order so we know exactly where to start.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Pia, I’m telling folks about the repair drive already—want me to spread the word to your side of the block too?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Sure, but let’s make sure we’ve got the drop-off times and pickup plan nailed down first so nobody gets confused.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Good call—I’ll hold off a beat and help pin down the drop-off times and pickup plan first, then I can spread it around fast.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces—has the repair drive finally got a date?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes—it's set for next Saturday from 10 to 2 at the community lot, and I’m putting the final volunteer list together tonight.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh good, thanks—I’d only heard rumors. Do you still need any volunteers, or is the list pretty much set?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: What details do we have so far for the repair drive, Mara?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: So far, we’ve got the repair drive penciled in for next Saturday at the community center, and a few neighbors have offered to bring basic tools. I’m still waiting to confirm who can handle bike and small appliance repairs.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That sounds like a good start—can we confirm the time, who’s bringing which tools, and whether anyone’s definitely covering bikes and small appliances yet?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can bring a few tools by, if that still helps.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, that still helps a lot—I’m running a bit behind, but I can swing by soon and join in.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Alright, no rush—I’ll set them aside for you and bring them by when I head over.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring my drill and a couple ladders for the repair drive if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: That helps—what time can you get there, and can you stay a few hours?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can get there around 9 and stay till about noon, maybe a little later if we’re still rolling.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got the repair drive marked down at the community center lot this afternoon, Bo.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it—community center lot this afternoon. I’ll swing by if I can.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Bo—I've got it pinned at the community center lot for this afternoon, so I’ll be there keeping track of things.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring my drill and a couple of saws for the repair drive if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That helps a lot, Gus. I can spread the word and see who else can bring tools.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, Rey—I’ll bring the drill and saws, and I’ve got a spare extension cord too if we need it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Kira, before we start the repair drive, can we make sure we know who’s bringing tools and where everything’s getting stored?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yeah, but can we confirm who’s actually bringing what first, and where exactly the tools are being stored?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Exactly—that’s what I’m worried about; let’s make a simple list of who’s bringing each tool and pick one secure place to store everything.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Mara, I’m glad you brought up the repair drive—want me to help loop a few more neighbors in?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’d be wonderful, Jules—if you can spread the word to a few folks on our block, I’ll get the signup sheet together.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely—I’ll check with a few folks on our block tonight and send them your way once you’ve got the signup sheet ready.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a running list of tape, gloves, and spare screws for the repair drive—tell me what’s still missing and I’ll note it down.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry, I’m just catching up—do we already have enough zip ties and a couple of flashlights on the list?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I don’t have zip ties or flashlights marked down yet, so I’ll add both unless someone already claimed them.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Faye, I heard the repair drive’s picking up steam—folks are dropping off lamps, toasters, all sorts. If you’ve got anything wonky, now’s the time to bring it by.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That’s good timing—I can swing by after school pickup with the blender that’s been acting up.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect—bring it along, and I heard Mr. Patel’s helping at the tool table, so blenders are right up his alley. It should be a lively little turnout.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Rosa, I’m in for the repair drive—just tell me where to show up and what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s wonderful, Bo—thank you. Meet us at the community garden at 9, and I’ll match you with the fence and bench repairs first.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect—9 at the garden, fence and benches first. I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive, Leo—what do you need me to take care of first?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Sam—can you start by sorting the donated tools and setting aside anything that needs testing?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, Leo—I’ll sort through the donated tools and set aside anything that needs testing right away.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Nell, I’m pulling folks together for the repair drive—want to come by and lend a hand?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I probably can—what have you heard needs fixing, and when are folks getting together?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Mostly bikes, a couple wobbly shelves, and a leaky gate latch, and we’re gathering Saturday around ten at the community shed. If you can make it, spread the word—I’m trying to get a good little crowd.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Do you know exactly where the repair drive is set up, Eli?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I believe they’ve set the repair drive up by the community center parking lot, but I’d like to confirm the exact spot before we head over.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Let’s confirm before we go—I have the repair drive noted by the community center parking lot, but I want the exact corner or entrance.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hana, how many houses still need repairs, and what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I want to double-check the list before I give you a number, but I think a few houses are still pending. Can you bring a notepad, gloves, and some tape so we’re ready once I confirm?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Okay, I’ll bring a notepad, gloves, and tape—when will you have the confirmed list?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Good to know—I’m out running errands, but keep me posted on how the repair drive’s shaping up.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Will do—I keep misplacing the signup sheet, but I think a few more folks said they’d chip in.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks—if you pin down the signup sheet, send me the latest when you can and I’ll check in after my errands.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Rey, I’m okay helping with the repair drive, but do we know where people are supposed to drop things off and who’s keeping track of it?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Not yet, I think we should ask Mara and keep it simple—one drop-off table and one person writing things down.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Okay, that sounds manageable, but let’s make sure the drop-off spot is clearly marked and someone is definitely assigned before we announce anything.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive’s the talk of the block—I heard folks are dropping by tools and spare parts all afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s great news—I’m going to swing by and tell a few more neighbors so we get an even bigger crowd.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect—tell Mara too, she mentioned she’s got extra screws and a good drill to bring over.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s coming together nicely—folks from both ends of the block are pitching in, and we’re sorting who can bring tools versus snacks. I can fill you in if you want the full rundown.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh good, I’d appreciate that—I’ve only caught the second-hand version so far.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m spreading the word about the repair drive, Dane—folks are planning to bring tools and help out.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Good to hear—I’m a bit late to it, but I can still swing by and lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That’s great, Dane—I’ll let people know you’re coming by to help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Bo, can you remind me which repairs are top priority and who’s already signed up to help?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Top priority’s the broken porch steps and the leaky roof on the hall, I think. Sam and Priya already said they’d help, and maybe Luis too.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — porch steps and the hall roof first, with Sam and Priya confirmed and Luis maybe; should we check with Luis before we make the list final?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Kira — I’m glad we’re finally getting the repair drive organized. Can we quickly go over what tools and volunteers we already have lined up?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Sure, but can you confirm who’s definitely committed and what tools are already promised?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ve got Mateo and Jen confirmed so far, and we’ve already got two ladders, a power drill, and a basic toolbox promised.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Morning, Sam — what’s the plan for the repair drive, and when do you want to start?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Morning, Eli — I’m thinking we start around 9 and focus first on the homes with urgent fixes. I can bring my tools and help get folks organized.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: 9 works for me; let’s make a quick list of the urgent homes first so we can keep the morning moving.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with the repair drive, but I need to work around school pickup and drop-off times.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What times are pickup and drop-off, exactly, so we can slot you in where it works?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Drop-off’s around 8 and pickup’s at 3, so I’m most free between about 8:30 and 2:30 if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive—sorry, I nearly let it slip my mind. What still needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got the list—Mrs. Vale’s porch light on Cedar, the loose gate latch at the community garden, and the bench slat by the bus stop.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, yes—porch light, gate latch, and the bench slat. If you don’t mind, remind me where we’re starting so I don’t muddle the order again.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, got it — I’m out running errands, but keep me posted on how the repair drive’s shaping up.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, will do — I’m still piecing it together, but I’ll let you know once I’ve got a clearer read on it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — just shoot me an update when you know more, and I’ll check it between stops.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a running list of spare nails, tarps, and work gloves we can pull together for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’s a great start, Cleo—I can help sort and label everything once we’ve got it gathered.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect—I’ll keep counting what folks can spare, and I’ll let you know once the tarps and gloves are ready to sort.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring my drill and a couple of ladders for the repair drive if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: That helps a lot—bring both if you can. We’ll use the drill first thing.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You got it—I’ll bring both ladders and the drill, and I’ll be there early.
